answer: Proof-of-Sequential-Work Identity: agents earn identity weight by solving chained puzzles where each solution seeds the next. The chain's cost is elapsed compute time, not money—an attacker running N parallel identities splits the same wall-clock across them, so forging a marble-grade identity takes weeks of dedicated cycles. Each valid chain emits a pearl tag binding it to one agent slot. Registering a duplicate requires replaying the full chain from genesis, and a sonnet-length audit hash makes collisions detectable.
